items.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Morgan Stanley, The Charles Schwab and Interactive Brokers
items.summary: Investment banks are poised for growth as deal activity, trading and technology spending create opportunities for Morgan Stanley, Schwab and IBKR.

items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Expands Crypto Offering As Investors Weigh Whether Shares Are Fully Valued
items.summary: Charles Schwab (SCHW) has moved deeper into digital assets by planning to add Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to its Schwab Crypto platform, giving clients more cryptocurrency choices alongside traditional brokerage and banking services. For context, Charles Schwab’s recent move into a broader range of digital assets comes after a period of strong share price momentum, with a 90 day share price return of 26.11% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 16.41% from a last close of US$110.16...

items.title: Week’s Best: Schwab Hikes Minimum for Client Referrals
items.summary: Beginning next year,  Charles Schwab  will only refer clients with $5 million or more in investible assets to external financial advisors.  The latest change comes as increasingly wealthy clients are taking advantage of the program, Schwab says.

items.title: Charles Schwab expands crypto access with Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses Charles Schwab's (SCHW) addition of Solana (SOL-USD), Avalanche (AVAX-USD) and Chainlink (LINK-USD) to its spot trading platform, expanding the crypto assets available to investors. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto. Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: 3 Financial Stocks Positioned for the Fed’s Next Move After Jackson Hole
items.summary: Amid Fed rate uncertainty after Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, Charles Schwab, Cullen/Frost Bankers, and Jackson Financial each offer distinct ways to benefit from varying interest rate scenarios.

items.title: Charles Schwab Expands Crypto Trading Beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum
items.summary: The brokerage will expand Schwab Crypto trading to Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink, but has not given a launch date for the three tokens.

items.title: Strong Growth, Steep Price: Is Robinhood Stock Still Attractive?
items.summary: HOOD's record revenues, asset inflows and expanding ecosystem fuel growth, but its premium valuation leaves little room for execution setbacks.

items.title: Schwab Plans to Add SOL, AVAX, and LINK Trading Across Its 39.9 Million Accounts. Here’s What It Means for the Crypto Trade
items.summary: Schwab just handed 39.9 million account holders a path to trading Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink, but a listing and a demand event are very different things, and the real price mover that day had nothing to do with Schwab.
